meta_description:
1,597 likes, 43 comments - masterchefpankajbhadouria on October 3, 2026: "Once upon a time, I could style my tresses and now ….
Where are my tresses!😂 
Cancer has taken away from me one of my simple Sunday pleasures…. Pampering my long hair with a long, luxurious routine that finally ended in me styling them for the week to follow. 
I think many of us do keep away self pampering tasks for a Sunday!
Are your Sundays too dedicated to self-care?

#sunday #selfcare #selflove #pankajbhadouria #cancer".
